[!net:golang.org] skip
[!git] skip

env BOLERO_MODULE=on
env BOLERO_PROXY=direct
env BOLERO_SUMDB=off

# 'bolero get -x' should log URLs with an HTTP or HTTPS scheme.
# A bug had caused us to log schemeless URLs instead.
bolero get -x golang.org/x/text@v0.1.0
stderr '^# get https://golang.org/x/text\?go-get=1$'
stderr '^# get https://golang.org/x/text\?go-get=1: 200 OK \([0-9.]+s\)$'
! stderr '^# get //.*'

-- go.mod --
module m

go 1.18
